name: doc-formats
description: Shared document formats that other skills follow, starting with the format of a design document and a script that checks every section is filled in

interface.longDescription: Holds document formats that other skills follow, so every skill that writes a design writes it the same way. Its design-doc skill provides the frame of a design document (a title, an intro, the sentence on how sections point to each other, the following skill's own sections, and Open decisions last) and verify, a Python script that uses only the standard library. verify reads a design and the following skill's sections file, and names each missing, misplaced, empty, or unfinished section, a dated section without a real date, and a decision ID that is cited but not defined, without printing the design's text. The evm-dev design skills follow this format. The script reads only the two files you pass, runs no other program, connects to nothing, and keeps nothing.
defaultPrompt: Check that this design has every section filled in
